title: Shops and Establishments (Maharashtra)
summary: Under the Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act, 2017 and Rules, 2018: fewer than ten workers file an online intimation (Form F); ten or more apply for registration (Form A). Then display the notice of working hours (Form M).

sources.title: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2018

steps.title: File an online intimation (Form F)
steps.description: An establishment engaging less than ten workers submits an online intimation of commencement of business in Form F; a receipt is issued online in Form G.

documents.name: Aadhaar card of the employer (for a company: of the responsible person)
Photo of the establishment showing the interior and the Marathi name board

fee.note: No fee is prescribed under the Act and rules; the employer pays electronic transaction or service charges fixed by the Government.

steps.title: Apply for registration (Form A)
steps.description: An establishment engaging ten or more workers applies online in Form A; the Facilitator scrutinises it and issues a digitally signed registration certificate in Form B.

documents.name: Aadhaar card of the employer (for a company: of the responsible person)
Photo of the establishment showing the interior and the Marathi name board
Licences or registrations mandatory under any other law before starting the business
Premises proof
documents.note: Owned: sale deed, property tax receipt, electricity bill or society maintenance receipt. Rented/leased: lease or leave and licence agreement plus one owner's document.

documents.name: NOC from the family member or relative (if they own, lease or rent the premises)
NOC from the housing society (if in a residential society)

fee.note: No fee is prescribed under the Act and rules; the employer pays electronic transaction or service charges fixed by the Government.

officialSla.wording: RTS list: "1 Days" (working or calendar not stated). Rules 2018, rule 5(1): certificate "within working seven days".

steps.title: Display the notice of working hours (Form M)
steps.description: Every employer displays, on its website and on a notice board at a conspicuous place of the premises, the hours of work, rest interval and weekly holiday in Form M.

forms.name: Notice of hours of work, rest interval, weekly holiday

fee.note: No fee is prescribed under the Act and rules.
